name: head-agent-core
description: Provider-neutral HEAD continuity with a small constitutional core and optional review-gated Product, Graph, and execution governance.

interface.longDescription: A provider-neutral HEAD core that preserves one Project and Session across providers. Ordinary work uses a small constitutional default; Product/Graph onboarding, durable Runs, compaction recovery, bounded workers, and host coordination activate only when their protected outcome requires them.

defaultPrompt: Initialize or resume this project with the small provider-neutral HEAD core.
Inspect Core and Product readiness, the next action, and optional capability prerequisites without activating or authorizing anything.
Preview exact-task context, automatically expand fixed budget tiers only for proven context-budget exclusion, and distinguish mechanical coverage from HEAD-owned semantic sufficiency.
Explicitly activate Product onboarding and prepare an evidence-linked candidate batch without changing Product Canon.
Choose the lightest safe Observe, Session, Run, or Authority lane for this task.
Preview minimum sufficient context for this exact task and report coverage separately from semantic sufficiency.
Create and execute one durable whole-plan Run, then return its ResultPacket for Fresh HEAD review.
Recover the current HEAD direction from fixed Project, Session, and checkpoint artifacts after context loss.
Prepare and verify an intentional compaction without treating the provider summary as recovery authority.
Inspect the Graph and record boundary without treating derived projections as Canon or unique recovery state.
Prepare bounded current Context evidence from only my task, then author EvidenceNeeds and exact graph anchors in the conversation without asking me for JSON.
Propose exact current graph anchors for this task, then let Core verify only bounded inclusion and lineage.
Dispatch a bounded worker outcome without widening its authorization or allowing it to approve itself.
Inspect provider-specific capabilities while preserving provider-neutral Core semantics.
Observe host deployment results against exact current product Git refs without granting deployment, Product Canon, or recovery authority.
